arithmetic.value_unit: thousands of nominal USD; dollar columns multiply by exactly 1000

exposures.grain: year × source BACI country_code × direction × HS92 hs6
exposures.direction: import: all observed origins to an in-scope importer; export: all observed destinations of an in-scope exporter
exposures.country_code: Original BACI source-area identity. Former Sudan 736 and current Sudan 729 are separate even if ISO3 labels match.
exposures.hs6: Exact source-listed HS92 code; includes flagged legacy nonstandard codes such as 9999AA.
exposures.product_is_standard_hs6: True only for six ASCII digits. False source-listed legacy codes are retained separately and must not enter HS2/HS4 hierarchy aggregates.
exposures.country_scope_status: Versioned source-area cohort label from the country mapping; historical_predecessor is not a modern member.
exposures.country_current_member: Modern Arab League membership cohort flag; not membership reconstructed for the trade year.
exposures.total_value_1000usd: Exact sum of recorded bilateral values in thousands of current USD, all observed partners.
exposures.total_value_usd: Exact total_value_1000usd × 1000. Reconciled FOB merchandise value; not inflation-adjusted.
exposures.observed_partner_count: Distinct counterparties with an input row, including a zero if supplied to the derivation API.
exposures.partner_count: Distinct counterparties with positive value. Production BACI ingestion requires positive source values.
exposures.top1_partner_code: Largest positive-value source/destination BACI code; ties broken by ascending source code, without implying a meaningful difference.
exposures.top1_share: top1 value divided by all observed market value; null for zero denominator.
exposures.top3_partner_codes: Up to three positive-value counterparties, descending value then ascending source code.
exposures.top3_value_1000usd: Exact sum for up to three largest positive-value counterparties.
exposures.top3_share: top3 value divided by all observed market value; null for zero denominator.
exposures.hhi: Sum of squared counterparty value shares in [0,1], unnormalized; null for zero denominator.
exposures.effective_partner_count: 1/hhi, a concentration statistic, not a count of independent firms or physical producers.
exposures.intra_scope_value_1000usd: Exact counterparty value whose source-area in_scope flag is true, including explicitly retained historical predecessors.
exposures.intra_scope_share: intra_scope value / all observed value. Historical scope is not a fixed-territory regional time series.
exposures.intra_current_member_value_1000usd: Exact counterparty value for the modern membership cohort; historical predecessor is excluded.
exposures.intra_current_member_share: intra_current_member value / all observed value; modern cohort, not contemporaneous membership.
exposures.positive_quantity_rows: Bilateral rows with recorded quantity > 0; quantities may be reconciled/estimated upstream.
exposures.missing_quantity_rows: Bilateral rows whose typed quantity is null; distinct from recorded zero.
exposures.nonpositive_quantity_rows: Bilateral rows with a non-null quantity <= 0 (production ingest permits rounded zero).
exposures.quantity_covered_value_1000usd: Exact value of rows with quantity > 0.
exposures.quantity_value_coverage_share: quantity-covered value / total market value. Not quantity accuracy or a transaction-price guarantee.
exposures.source_version: Single BACI release version shared by inputs.
exposures.source_archive_sha256: SHA-256 of the original source ZIP shared by inputs.
exposures.limitations: Only recorded reconciled merchandise trade. Source-country concentration is not domestic import dependence, disruption risk, production origin, spare capacity, supplier replaceability or firm concentration.

global_context.global_value_1000usd: Exact sum across the full worldwide product-supplier aggregate, including non-Arab-to-non-Arab trade.
global_context.observed_supplier_count: Source BACI exporter areas present in the global aggregate.
global_context.global_supplier_hhi: Unnormalized HHI of each source area's total world exports of this product. Re-exporters/hubs are not necessarily producers.
global_context.global_effective_supplier_count: 1/global_supplier_hhi; not a count of production firms.
global_context.top1_exporter_code: Largest exporter area by full worldwide value; ascending BACI code breaks ties.
global_context.top1_exporter_value_1000usd: Exact total world exports by the top exporter area.
global_context.top1_exporter_share: Top exporter's value / global product value.
global_context.top3_exporter_codes: Up to three positive-value exporters, descending value then ascending BACI code.
global_context.top3_exporter_value_1000usd: Exact total for top three exporter areas.
global_context.top3_exporter_share: Top three exporters' value / global product value.
global_context.intra_scope_exporter_share: Share of world product export value attributed to in-scope exporter areas; not their global production share.
global_context.current_member_exporter_share: Share of world product export value attributed to the modern membership cohort.

link_observation_changes.grain: previous_year × year × exporter_code × importer_code × hs6; only links whose physical record presence changed
link_observation_changes.observation_change: newly_observed or no_longer_observed. Record absence is not a verified trade zero, market entry/exit or disruption.
link_observation_changes.present_previous: True only if a source flow record exists in previous_year.
link_observation_changes.present_current: True only if a source flow record exists in year.
link_observation_changes.previous_value_1000usd: Exact previous recorded value, null if absent; a numeric zero remains a present record.
link_observation_changes.current_value_1000usd: Exact current recorded value, null if absent.
link_observation_changes.window_rule: Only adjacent, parse-complete annual members within the same source archive/version. First/last source years are censored; no transition bridges a missing year.
